Lockheed Martin develops innovative solutions to complex national security and mission challenges. The company is seeking an Early Career Software Engineer to support simulation and training products by working on software and test execution for advanced combat system representations.
Software engineer executing simulation and training software tests

Responsibilities:
• In this role, you will work on software and test execution

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or Electrical Computer Engineering or in a closely related field
• Experience using C/C++, Java, and/or Python
• Must be a US Citizen
• this position will require a government security clearance
• This position is located at a facility that requires special access

Preferred:
• Experience with Network Topology Configuration, Modeling Tools, Static Code Analysis tools
• Experience in Model Based Engineering and related tools
• Experience with the Atlassian tool suite (Jira, Bitbucket, Crucible, Confluence) or Gitlab
• Strong analytical and trouble shooting skills required
• Familiarity with Linux and/or Unix
